user.title: Atios SmartCore (expert)
user.description: This sets up direct raw-DALI access to the SmartCore. For everyday light control, most users should instead pair the SmartCore via Matter (DALI Configurator → Accessory Manager → Matter). Enter the SmartCore IP address or hostname.

dali_ip_interface_disabled.title: SmartCore DALI IP Interface is off
dali_ip_interface_disabled.description:
The SmartCore at {host} has its "DALI IP Interface" setting turned off, so it sends no DALI bus events to Home Assistant: button, occupancy and light-level entities and the `atios_dali_event` event stay silent. Lights are not affected.

To fix it, open the SmartCore web interface, go to **System → DALI** and turn on **DALI IP Interface**. This notice clears itself as soon as the first bus event arrives.

lunatone_socket_silent.title: SmartCore does not stream DALI events
lunatone_socket_silent.description:
Home Assistant is connected to the SmartCore at {host} (firmware {version}), but the device never answers on its DALI IP websocket, so button, occupancy and light-level entities and the `atios_dali_event` event stay silent. Lights are not affected.

This is a SmartCore firmware bug: firmware built on ESP-IDF v5.5.5/v6.0.1+ (seen on 3.2.2) never registers websocket clients and drops everything it would send them. Update the SmartCore to a firmware with the fix. This notice clears itself as soon as the device starts talking.
